section_skill: Compare a side business and a full-time business
outcome_title: Compare a side business with a full-time business by time, income needs and risk
intro: A side business runs alongside a job or school. A full-time business is your main work and main income. A side business usually has less risk, because a paycheck or other income still covers living costs while you test the idea, but it has less time. A full-time business has more time but more risk: if sales are slow, personal bills may go unpaid. wrong_choices: A: a large loan adds risk before demand is known | B: a lease is a big commitment before testing | D: this removes her steady income before the idea is tested
